scope: The maintained case owns a four-stage npn13G2 voltage amplifier and validates its 100 MHz small-signal behavior after layout extraction.

source_boundary.source_tap: RSUB VSS SUBSTRATE ptap1 A=4e-12 P=8e-6 R=81.6666667

native_extraction.klayout: The strict KLayout net-only netlist is authoritative for the four HBT geometries, all modelled resistors, and the physical ptap1 card from VSS to the ordinary substrate body node. The four rsil lengths are intentionally distinct (20.00/20.01/20.02/20.03 um) so repeated emitter contacts have candidate-derived identity.
native_extraction.magic: Magic RC extraction is authoritative for distributed interconnect resistance and capacitance. Its SG13G2 compact HBT cards expose the PDK substrate through the named VSS body boundary; Magic tap geometry is not used to invent a source schematic node.
native_extraction.candidate_configuration: The parasitic backend records disable_tap_extraction=true. This changes only candidate KLayout extraction, omitting the standard tap primitive at the approved body boundary; physical LVS still uses the strict source netlist and explicit finite ptap1 geometry.
native_extraction.approved_boundary: The only cross-extractor alias permitted is the SG13G2 substrate boundary: KLayout's one internal HBT body domain, proven by its physical ptap1 return, may correspond to Magic's HBT body terminal VSS. HBT collector, base, emitter, top-level ports, resistor terminals, and resistor geometry remain candidate-derived and must be mapped by device identity and retained passive connectivity. The RC merger may omit Magic's standard substrate tap from distributed-RC primitives when it is the same body boundary; the finite source tap remains in the source/native calibration deck.
native_extraction.post_layout_simulation: The post-layout deck consumes the merged candidate-derived netlist and measures only named top-level terminals. It contains no references to internal schematic node names.

calibration.nominal_acceptance: Pre-layout and candidate-derived post-layout decks use the same testbench and parameter values. Nominal amplification, output headroom, and supply current are checked at named terminals; a VBIAS sensitivity sweep documents the usable bias window and the high-bias saturation counterexample. Internal stage nodes are diagnostic-only source/native calibration observations.

body_calibration.finite_source: Every modelled bulk uses SUBSTRATE and RSUB is the finite ptap1 equivalent R=81.6666667 ohm.
body_calibration.ideal_comparison: For a nominal diagnostic only, replace each modelled bulk SUBSTRATE by VSS and remove RSUB. This quantifies the approved Magic body-boundary idealization; it is not the task source circuit and is not a qualification input.
body_calibration.acceptance_rule: The finite and ideal nominal terminal metrics must agree within the recorded calibration tolerance before accepting the body-boundary idealization in post-layout simulation.

limitations: This case does not claim 160 GHz gain, noise figure, compression point, S-parameters, or RF transmission-line fidelity.
It does not claim a calibrated noise figure because the pinned HBT support is used for deterministic voltage-gain/DC qualification only.
